assets.role: illustrated target; not a game screenshot
assets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: reference-matched target screenshot of an exhilarating first-person 2.5D browser arena shooter, landscape 16:9. Input image 1 is the visual authority: preserve its heavy charcoal printmaking line work, creamy ivory paper weapon surfaces, strong turquoise sky and distant towers, deep violet-black ink ground, irregular crosshatching and rich comic aesthetic. Do not turn it into clean gray polygon graphics, neon science fiction, parchment website UI, or a realistic game. Create ONE coherent full-width gameplay frame rather than split panels. Scene: a layered ruined ink fortress arena with chunky ivory crates, purple shadowed arches, cyan atmospheric distant skyline; a few visually distinct stylized ink creatures, lean humanoid, spiky crawling insect, broad horned brute, coherent ivory-and-charcoal anatomy, no gore. First-person white-paper shotgun and drawn hands at lower right firing a dramatic golden angular muzzle burst; clear center reticle and readable target silhouettes, short gold tracer and tiny red ink contact star on target, ejected case, a few paper fragments. Massive expressive comic energy with a controlled golden explosion at one distant side of the arena, no blast covering crosshair. HUD must look like part of a hand-printed action comic: top-left small ivory torn-paper combo card with bold ink number 24 and smaller COMBO; top-center compact WAVE 03 ink stamp; bottom-left irregular red ink health backing plus ivory cross and readable 100; bottom-right small ivory ammo count 4 / 6 with simple shell pips; lower middle subtle turquoise dash readiness icon; one brief angled KABAM! comic word near the distant explosion, not a full-screen title. Numbers and text remain live-UI style composition references, not readable body copy. Bold condensed hand-painted lettering, high legibility at thumbnail, avoid tiny labels and excessive HUD chrome. Strong directional speed and action without a cluttered center. Crisp detailed publishable image, no watermark. This is an ART TARGET, not an actual screenshot of implemented gameplay.

assets.role: candidate shape sheet; not a registered atlas or approved temporal sequence
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable transparent special-effects concept sheet for a paper-and-ink action video game. Match the supplied reference's bold black hand-ink contours, coarse expressive paper texture, golden yellow bursts, tiny red graphic ink accents, cyan and violet energy. Produce exactly TWELVE separate isolated effect shapes in a spacious four-column by three-row arrangement on a TRUE fully transparent RGBA background. NO labels, NO borders, NO checkerboard, NO scene, weapons, people or creatures. Row1: three distinct angular golden muzzle-star shapes (small, wide, jagged) and one thin gold spark fan. Row2: a cyan impact ring with transparent middle, a violet-cyan energetic pulse, a short ivory curling smoke puff with gentle alpha falloff, and a cluster of separated ivory-and-charcoal paper chips. Row3: four phases of ONE golden comic explosion accent, compact flash, peak jagged bloom, outward fragments, and faint final flecks. Keep these four phases centered within their own equally sized cells with matching origin. All twelve elements fully contained with ample transparent gutters, no overlapping neighbors or clipped spikes. Solid ivory highlights must remain opaque; empty space genuinely transparent; luminous tips may fade softly. Crisp readable silhouette, controlled limited glow, not photorealistic smoke or generic neon particles. These are candidate source art for review and packing, not a guarantee of pixel-perfect atlas metadata. Avoid black rectangles and matte halos.

assets.role: eight key poses; not one complete run loop or rig
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: eight-key-pose animation concept sheet for a reference-matched paper-and-ink monster. Input image is visual style and creature design reference, NOT a background to retain. Focus on a lean hulking charcoal ink humanoid with an ivory skull-like mask, long clawed forearms, broad hunched shoulders, torn ivory paper highlights and a small turquoise throat accent. Closer to the energetic ink creatures in the reference than a cute clean angular robot or superhero. Non-graphic fantasy creature, no wounds or blood. Create exactly EIGHT full-body poses of the SAME creature in a spacious four-column by two-row sheet, all seen from the exact same front three-quarter camera, full feet and hands visible, stable design and scale, body heading fixed. Pose order: ready crouch, run contact left, run passing, run contact right, attack windup, attack extension, impact recoil, defeat crouch turning into a few paper flecks. The run poses are key poses only, not a claim of a complete cyclic eight-frame run. Keep identical mask markings, limb lengths, torso width and anatomy across poses; each silhouette separate with ample transparent gutters and margin. Stable ground baseline in each row, no ground plane, cast shadows, background, labels, HUD, lettering, checkerboard or watermark. Actual transparent RGBA background. Opaque ivory highlights, bold charcoal line work, restrained coarse printmaking crosshatching, violet reflected shading, tiny cyan accent, legible at small size. This is a pose guide for review and possible cutout-rig development, not a precision atlas; do not add a skeleton diagram. No guns, flashes or scenery.
